name: Greater Videnth
description: An island on Dominaria north of Umber and northeast of Terisiare, more than 1200 berim north of New Argive.

description_citations.text: "Greater Videnth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Some Argivian scholars posit that Argoth was Little Videnth and most of Terisiare lies on Greater Videnth; opponents note the lack of resemblance.
timeline.quote: They believe that it is far more likely that ancient Argoth is, in fact, Little Videnth Island

citation.text: "Greater Videnth", section "The Videnthian Theory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Lies just east of the main island.
relations.quote: Just east of the main island lies Little Videnth Island .
